purpose: Planning profile only. This is not an executable training job and no 10B checkpoint exists.

tokenizer.warning: Byte-level tokenization is an inefficient temporary prototype for Turkish. A reviewed production subword tokenizer and matching inference runtime are prerequisites.

blockers: No production source is approved and model_training_allowed remains false.
The current trainer's memory preflight does not compute safe per-rank memory for a 10B DDP plus optimizer-sharded run.
No named cloud GPU topology, price cap, data retention plan, or private runner is configured.
The production tokenizer and a 10B-scale throughput/recovery benchmark are not validated.

hardware.note: Conservative capacity-planning placeholders, not a validated fit or price estimate. Confirm with a small measured distributed pilot and provider quote.

caveats: The exact count is calculated from the current decoder dimensions; it is not a trained model or a quality claim.

BF16 weights alone require about 20.1 GB decimal (18.8 GiB); the trainer's simple 16-byte-per-parameter state estimate is about 161.1 GB decimal (150 GiB), before activation/communication/workspace overhead.
DDP replicates model weights and gradients on each rank. Optimizer-state sharding alone is not FSDP/ZeRO-3 and does not shard model parameters.
A 20-tokens-per-parameter planning heuristic implies about 201 billion training tokens; it is not a guarantee, corpus-size estimate, or approved data requirement.
The configured profile is deliberately blocked and must not be used to start training until every named blocker is independently resolved and reviewed.
